titulo: Terminada la clase... = once the class was over
subtitulo: Terminada la ceremonia, nos fuimos a la fiesta.
regla: A past participle at the start of a sentence can open a time clause: once / after something has happened: Terminada la ceremonia, nos fuimos a la fiesta. The participle agrees with its noun and goes first. Una vez can come before it: Una vez dormidos los niños...

bloques.texto: Meaning: _once / after X (has) happened_. The participle action comes **first** in time.
The participle **goes first** and **agrees** with its noun: **terminada la ceremonia**, **dormidos los niños**.
Works for past, present and future: the main verb sets the time.
Formal or written; in speech, **cuando / después de que**.
Tip: participle first, then the noun: it's a finished box you tick off.

lista.es: ==Terminada la ceremonia==, nos fuimos todos a la fiesta.
lista.en: Once the ceremony was over, we all went to the party.

lista.es: ==Aprobado este último examen==, ya estoy libre hasta septiembre.
lista.en: With this last exam passed, I'm free until September.

lista.es: ==Una vez dormidos los niños==, podremos cenar tranquilos.
lista.en: Once the kids are asleep, we'll be able to have a quiet dinner.

lista.es: ==Llegado el momento==, nos reunimos para decidir.
lista.en: When the time came, we met to decide.

lista.es: ==Servidas las entradas==, empezamos con el plato fuerte.
lista.en: Once the starters are served, we'll start on the main course.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Once dinner was served, we sat down._
In Spanish: _Once the decision is made, there's no turning back._
lista.r: Tomada la decisión, no hay vuelta atrás.
